purpose: post-hoc calibration on archived original GHXTox predictions; no neural training
cohort: 6387 historical original labels; original 3seed 1D plus historical 3D; existing 80%-cluster 5fold predictions
outer: choose rules on OOF rows from other four folds only; evaluate current fold once; ensure no group overlaps
upstream_leakage: base OOF values from other folds may have trained on evaluation fold and historical global Platt/threshold selected on all OOF; validation is crossfit only for postprocessor, not independently nested full pipeline or blind
directions: 0–1 Cys +low, 2–5 unchanged, >=6 Cys +high where high<=0; probability clipping [0,1]
selection: maximize unweighted MCC on development rows; ties favor baseline and smaller absolute adjustments, then threshold nearest baseline; fixed before evaluation

arms.C_fixed: adjusted p, fixed historical threshold; dev-select offsets
arms.C_joint: adjusted p, dev-select offsets and threshold (same threshold candidates as B)

primary: A/B/C_joint and C_fixed isolate effects; pooled + per-fold MCC,AUPRC,AUROC,Brier,logloss, FN, FP, low positive FN and high negative FP, flagged/unflagged; group bootstrap conditional fixed predictions
decision: direction, groups and candidate range are post-hoc based on previous error exploration; no data-based deployment or probability-calibration claim without independent validation
